Smart processes.
Higher profits.
Prinect Business.
Prinect Business integrates your business processes, your production, your analyses, and your customers into the smart print shop workflow. By automating your commercial processes you gain new freedom, maximize your margins and fulfill your customers’ wishes.
Watch the video
Contact us
We need your consent to load the YouTube Video service
We use a third party service to embed video content that may collect data about your activity. Please review the details and accept the service to watch this video.
More Information
Accept
The solution for the Smart Print Shop.
More than just MIS.
Prinect Business contains everything that you need to manage your commercial processes. And goes even further. Prinect Business not only integrates your customers and helps you to reduce touchpoints. Using intelligent processes, you simultaneously lay the foundation for industrial, automated production.
Print shop with unlimited possibilities.
Customer retention with Prinect Business.
With Prinect Business, orders stop falling through the cracks. Whether price requests, orders or printing approvals. Prinect assists you in dialog with your customers – easy, smart and online. Thanks to the close integration of costing and production, Prinect not only helps you to define the optimal production method. By taking your current utilization of production capacity into consideration, you can also dynamically adjust your prices. This not only saves you time and effort, but also improves your customer retention in the long term.
Intelligent planning and control.
Maximum productivity.
With Prinect, you plan for success. Job management enables you to quickly and easily define the optimal planning order. Prinect Business already identifies the appropriate gang run in the quotation phase in combination with the Prinect production workflow. In this way, you can always make efficient use of the maximum format of your presses and increase your sales opportunities in the long term. The result: reduced throughput times, lower costs and greater efficiency.
Order and materials management.
Maximum results.
With smart order processing, you only intervene when necessary. With Prinect Business, you no longer have to individually complete process steps like job processing and tracking, delivery or billing. Instead, these are predefined and can be called up with minimal effort. You avoid unproductive downtimes by means of the automation of your materials management. The result: you always have your material just in time, where you need it. This not only significantly reduces your workload; it also lowers your material costs.
An overall view at all times.
A system that thinks with you.
Which products are especially successful? Which customers are profitable to work with? Which price strategy is the best? Prinect Business gives you the answers. Whether administration or production, all information is recorded centrally and constantly updated. Prinect Business offers you extensive standard reports as well as the possibility to quickly and easily create individual evaluations. Using Business Intelligence, you base your decisions on meaningful analyses, without the need for IT specialists. With Prinect Business, you are kept up to date at all times, including via smartphone or tablet when on the move.
An impressive ROI.
More efficiency, less complexity.
With Prinect, you benefit right from the start. Instead of a large up-front investment and complex licensing agreements, Prinect Business involves a transparent and fair subscription model on the basis of a monthly usage fee. An additional benefit for you: with Prinect Business, your MIS is always up to date. You not only receive all updates and upgrades. In the event of a problem, you will receive support via the Prinect Service hotline quickly and with no complications. This is the certainty that your business deserves.
Prinect
Functions of Prinect Business.
Greater efficiency right from the start.
Whether commercial, packaging or label printing – Prinect Business is the solution for the smart print shop. Prinect not only helps you to integrate your customers from the start. Thanks to the close integration with your pressroom, Prinect Business also meets the requirements for smart production. Consequence: You increase your efficiency as well as the satisfaction and loyalty of your customers.
Prinect Business
Prinect workflows
Prinect Production
What customers say
Country Pines, USA
“In an environment where labor is harder and harder to find, these automated features are as much of a key player in the success of the system as the machine and lasers themselves.”
Tipolitografia Pagani, Italy
"We invested in Prinect to support the workflow of our increasingly automated and complex printing processes. Faster setup times allow us to save significant amounts of energy while improving overall productivity. At the same time, paper waste and downtime have been significantly reduced."
Grupo Vargas, Costa Rica
"We experienced a major boost in productivity, because all our users are now working simultaneously on the same platform, from prepress to finishing."
Aumüller Druck, Germany
"Since we started using Prinect Automatic Paper Stretch Compensation, our quality has become so good that we don't need any backing any more, nor do we need to tension the plate clamping bar."
Druckhaus Becker, Germany
"Prinect APSC works perfectly. Our printers are fascinated. Using this software for compensating paper stretch means we only need to load the plates in the press and make the first pull. We can start printing printing right away."
